Australia Considers Ban on Smart Glasses in Government Workplaces

The Australian government is considering a ban on the use of smart glasses in government workplaces. This potential policy aims to address security concerns associated with the technology. The move comes as smart glasses are being explored for various applications, including in manufacturing settings where they could enhance training, safety, and productivity through hands-free AI guidance. However, the effective implementation of such technology in industrial environments depends on companies establishing clear operational rules.
